# InterDent

> InterDent is a Dental Service Organization (DSO) supporting 150+ affiliated dental practices across the western United States with practice management, patient care services, and the Gentle Dental brand.

InterDent operates a network of dental practices including Gentle Dental and Capitol Dental Care across multiple states including Hawaii, Oregon, California, Arizona, Nevada, Oklahoma, Kansas, and Washington. The organization provides comprehensive support to dental practices and connects patients with affordable, quality dental care through its affiliated clinics.

## Key Topics

- Dental Service Organization (DSO)
- Gentle Dental network
